activities.name: Market Battle — First Market Decision
activities.description: 5-round real-time decision battle analyzing RELIANCE price action, risk-to-reward ratios, and stop-loss placement.

rounds.title: Opening Bell & Sentiment
rounds.scenarioTitle: Round 1: Market Opening Gap & Initial Reaction
rounds.scenarioDescription: The market opens at 9:15 AM IST. RELIANCE opened higher by +1.53% relative to previous close (₹2907.7). Market breadth is positive across Indian indices, and initial buying interest is absorbing morning sell orders. What is your trading stance?
rounds.optimalRationale: A modest opening gap above previous close with initial morning accumulation supports buying with a tight stop-loss below the opening low.

rounds.title: Trend Continuation & Support
rounds.scenarioTitle: Round 2: Upward Momentum Testing Local Highs
rounds.scenarioDescription: By mid-morning, RELIANCE has steadily pushed to ₹2987.69 (+2.75%). Buyers have formed a series of higher lows on the 15-minute chart. The stock is approaching a known resistance band. Do you add to position, protect gains, or trim?
rounds.optimalRationale: Holding existing long positions allows winners to compound while trailing stop loss to entry protects capital from premature exits.

rounds.title: Institutional Volume Surge
rounds.scenarioTitle: Round 3: Heavy Volume Breakout Through Resistance
rounds.scenarioDescription: Large block deals hit the tape! Volume has spiked to 2.5x the hourly average as RELIANCE decisively breaks above key resistance to ₹3041.47 (+4.6%). Momentum indicators are overbought, but institutional participation is heavy. What is your risk-adjusted decision?
rounds.optimalRationale: A high-volume breakout often carries follow-through momentum. Holding with a tightened target or booking partial gains at target is disciplined.

rounds.title: Sector Shakeout & Volatility Dip
rounds.scenarioTitle: Round 4: Sudden Macro Pullback & Retest
rounds.scenarioDescription: A sudden drop in global crude/currency triggers a wave of profit-taking. RELIANCE dips from its highs down to ₹2995.85 (+3.03%). Fear spreads on social channels, but price is holding above the morning breakout level. How do you handle this risk event?
rounds.optimalRationale: Buying the retest of prior resistance (now acting as support) offers an exceptional risk-to-reward ratio with a clearly defined stop loss just below support.

rounds.title: Closing Auction & Final Decision
rounds.scenarioTitle: Round 5: Closing Bell Auction & Position Review
rounds.scenarioDescription: It is 3:15 PM IST — the final 15 minutes of the trading session. RELIANCE has rebounded from the shakeout low to close strongly at ₹3040.79 (+4.58%). Delivery volumes are being locked in ahead of tomorrow's session. Formulate your final decision.
rounds.optimalRationale: Closing near the day high with heavy delivery volumes indicates institutional accumulation that favors carrying overnight or taking target profits.
